name: Triple Whale
description: Connect Claude to Triple Whale and ask questions about your business across every channel in plain language. Pull KPIs, compare channels, break down performance, and understand what changed and what's driving results, all without writing SQL or switching dashboards. Every answer is grounded in your Triple Whale data and scoped to your store, timezone, and currency, so Claude works from the same source of truth your team already trusts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Triple Whale to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Triple Whale to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.triplewhale.com/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Triple Whale MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Triple Whale provides these MCP tools: explain-metric-change, find-sql-examples, get-available-tables, get-date-range, get-shop-info, get-summary-kpis, get-table-schemas, pixel-attribution, run-sql, and search-knowledge-base.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Triple Whale?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Triple Whale in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Triple Whale MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Triple Whale requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Triple Whale is developed by Triple Whale. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
